title: feat(plugin-audit): mark in-product AI writes on sys_audit_log rows (agent, conversation, confirmation)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WZvQNanG3W23XFGRFXLDAt)_
Fixes #33694

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. **改了什么**：产品内 AI 替某人改记录时，审计日志那一行现在写明是哪个 AI（`performed_by`）、替谁（`on_behalf_of`）、在哪次对话（`conversation_id`）、经哪次确认（`confirmation_id`，没确认就不写）。
2. **为什么改**：之前 AI 改的数据在审计日志里和本人手改一模一样，回答不了「这条是 AI 替张三在哪次对话里改的」；契约字段早已在 main（#33786），只差审计写入器去读。
3. **风险与回滚**：只加 metadata 键，`user_id` / `actor` 仍是本人，人手改的行不变；回滚即撤本 PR，历史行不受影响。
4. **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`（`performedBy` 取值与 metadata 拼装两处）、`agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe、`packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts` 的 describe 改句。
5. **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts`，预期 15 条全绿，其中 6 条是本卡新用例。
6. **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The record-write audit writer reads the in-product AI performer.** `audit-writers.ts` read only `provenance.performedByClientId` (the /mcp OAuth client). It now also reads `provenance.performedByAgentId`, `performedByConversationId` and `performedByConfirmationId`, which `buildProvenance` already copies from `ExecutionContext.performedBy` (#33786, PR #34018). On a row the in-product AI wrote for a person, `sys_audit_log.metadata` carries:
  - `performed_by`: the agent, beside `on_behalf_of`: the person (the existing pair, per the owner ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#3826 「3826 照建议（征询版）」: reuse `performed_by` / `on_behalf_of`, no new actor vocabulary);
  - `conversation_id`: the AI conversation;
  - `confirmation_id`: the pending item the person's approval decided, only when there was one.
  `user_id` and `actor` stay the person (ADR-0073 D3, ADR-0118 D1/D5). A personal write still carries no metadata. `conversation_id` / `confirmation_id` are written only when the in-product agent is the recorded performer, never beside an OAuth client id. If an envelope ever carried both `clientId` and `agentId` (each producer sets only its own), the row records the OAuth client and drops the agent with its two marks.
- **Spec describes.** The `ExecutionContext.performedBy` and `HookContext.provenance.performedByAgentId` / `performedByConversationId` / `performedByConfirmationId` describes and JSDoc no longer say the audit writer "does not record them yet". They name the metadata keys; say that `performed_by` holds either an OAuth client id or an in-product agent name, and state only what a reader can tell from a row: a value matching the `client_id` of an existing `sys_oauth_application` row is an OAuth client; a row carrying `conversation_id` or `confirmation_id` names an in-product agent; a row meeting neither may name an agent or the client of a since-deleted application, which the row alone cannot tell apart; and the contract does not keep an agent name and a `client_id` from being the same string; state the both-performers precedence; and say the action-invocation, data-export and dataset-query rows still record `clientId` only. The `performedBy` JSDoc's "no key holds two id namespaces" sentence now names the audit key as the ruled exception. No schema shape change; `content/docs/references/**` regenerated (`gen:docs`).
- Changeset `.changeset/33694-audit-in-product-ai-performer.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-audit` patch, `@objectstack/spec` patch (describe text ships).

## Why

The in-product AI writes as the signed-in person, so its rows were byte-identical to that person's own edits on every attribution column. The contract fields that tell them apart landed in #33786; nothing recorded them.

## Tests

New top-level describe in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts` (the existing rule 4 harness: real kernel, `assembleExecutionContext`, objectql `buildProvenance`, the shipped `sys_audit_log` object and writer on sqlite-wasm). The person's envelope is built at the real door; `performedBy` is added as the in-product AI path stamps it (that producer lives outside this repository).

- CONTROL: the envelope is a `human` principal with no `performedBy`, and `user_id` / `actor` are the person on all four rows.
- A confirmed AI create records `{ performed_by, on_behalf_of, conversation_id, confirmation_id }`.
- An AI create that needed no confirmation records no `confirmation_id`.
- An AI update of a record the person created is marked on the update row; the person's own create row stays unmarked.
- An envelope naming an OAuth client beside a conversation and a confirmation records only `{ performed_by: client, on_behalf_of }`.
- An envelope naming both performers records the OAuth client, without the agent's marks.

The last two envelopes have no producer in the tree; they pin what the spec tells a reader.

No existing test changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two id namespaces in `performed_by`.** `performed_by` now holds an OAuth client id or an in-product agent name, as the ruling chose (accepted in contract review 6934640918). Round 2 answered its S1: the writer keys `conversation_id` / `confirmation_id` on the agent being the recorded performer (which also closes N1). Round 3 answers S2 (6936045381): the describes no longer claim every value is classifiable, since an OAuth application row can be deleted while audit rows keep its `client_id`; a permanent per-row discriminator would need a kind mark on the row, which is a ruling, not this PR. ADR-0151 D5 reason 2 and ADR-0090 D10 rule 4 wording stay with carrier #34057.
- **Out of scope, filed #34556:** the action-invocation, data-export and dataset-query writers (`action-invocation-audit.ts`, `data-export-audit.ts`, `dataset-query-audit.ts`) read `performedBy.clientId` only, so an in-product AI action run or export is still recorded as the person's own. The describes now say so.
- The `clientId` / `performedByClientId` describes now name the OAuth client by the `client_id` of its `sys_oauth_application` row (they said the row's id; the two columns differ).
- `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx` lists `ctx.provenance.performedByClientId` only; outside this card's file surface. Filed #34556.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs (head and gate list in the report comment on #33694)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-audit^...' build` under the verify lock: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 15 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` (after merging main): Test Files 101 passed, Tests 1676 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck`: exit 0, test-typecheck 0 errors.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/kernel/execution-context.test.ts src/data/hook.test.ts`: Tests 146 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated`: `content/docs/references/**` stale, regenerated with `--fix`, re-check green.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 → 0): `performedBy = performedByClientId ?? performedByAgentId` → `performedByClientId` reds the three AI-row tests (3 failed / 10 passed); restore blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Round 2 ablation: `agentIsRecordedPerformer = !performedByClientId && performedByAgentId !== undefined` → `performedBy !== undefined` reds the two new pins (2 failed / 13 passed); restore blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.

- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
